newsitem.title: UK: Venezuelan oil output at 3 mbpd - finance minister.
newsitem.headline: Venezuelan oil output at 3 mbpd - finance minister.

text.p: Venezuelan oil output is running at capacity of three million barrels per day (bpd), Finance Minister Luis Raul Matos Azocar said on Thursday.
"We're producing at top capacity at the moment. It's three million barrels per day," Matos told reporters after an address at the Bank of England.
It was not clear whether Matos was referring to crude production or also including natural gas liquids and condensates.
Venezuela has an OPEC crude output quota of 2.359 million bpd and repeatedly has refuted allegations that it pumps excess.

A Reuters survey of OPEC output put Venezuelan crude output at 3.12 million bpd in September. Venezuela oil industry sources said the country has pumped as much as 3.3 million bpd in recent months but is averaging around 3.1-3.2 million bpd.
Matos said Caracas planned to raise production by 6-7 per cent a year to reach six million bpd by 2006, helped by the return last year of foreign oil investment.
Matos said there was no question of the Latin American oil producer leaving OPEC despite the group's declining role since the 1970s in setting the price of oil.
"We are there. We are going to stay there," Matos said.
